input.question: Which person or organization did Andrew Worster work for?

documents.text:
Andrew Worster

Andrew Worster is a researcher who has made significant contributions to the field of medicine. One of his notable affiliations is with the McMaster University Faculty of Health Sciences, a prestigious medical school in Canada. Career

Andrew Worster has had a distinguished career as a researcher, and his work has been recognized and respected by the academic community. One of the most notable aspects of his career is his association with the McMaster University Faculty of Health Sciences. Association with McMaster University Faculty of Health Sciences

Andrew Worster has worked as a researcher at the McMaster University Faculty of Health Sciences, a renowned medical school in Canada. This faculty is known for its excellence in medical education, research, and patient care. Worster's work at the faculty has contributed significantly to the advancement of medical knowledge and practice. Evidence of Association

Multiple credible sources confirm Andrew Worster's association with the McMaster University Faculty of Health Sciences. According to his profile on the McMaster University website, Worster is listed as a faculty member at the Department of Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences. [1] Additionally, several research papers and publications co-authored by Worster have been affiliated with the McMaster University Faculty of Health Sciences, further substantiating his connection to the institution. [2][3]
